tier: CONFIRMATORY (enabled by true-PIT WRDS/IBES data; survivorship-free incl. delisted)
estimand: Sharpe of excess returns: Sharpe(strat - SPY)
data: I/B/E/S Summary History via WRDS (statpers = archived as-of snapshot; PIT). NOT free — institutional access required. Linked to the survivorship-free universe via oftic/cusip.
pit_contract: IbesSignalStrategy uses the latest statpers STRICTLY < rebal date; max_staleness_days=100 (~3 monthly snapshots). validate_ibes_pit asserts no statpers>=decision leaks.

confirmatory_family.name: est_revision_momentum
confirmatory_family.signal: trailing-3mo change in FY1 mean consensus EPS, scaled by |prior|; top decile long
confirmatory_family.literature: So (2013) ~5.8%/yr OOS; Chan-Jegadeesh-Lakonishok (1996); Mill Street ~7.6%/yr gross decile, IC 0.23
confirmatory_family.expected_band_note: half-literature, NET of monthly turnover cost; the single highest-probability analyst signal but evidence says large-cap value-weighted net likely lands +0.15-0.35 (Holm-killable). Pre-registered expectation: most likely FAILS, but this is the ONE signal with a credible path.

confirmatory_family.name: recommendation_consensus
confirmatory_family.signal: -meanrec (1=strong buy..5=sell; higher=more buy); top decile long
confirmatory_family.literature: Barber-Lehavy-McNichols-Trueman (2001): net long-only ~0; Engelberg-McLean-Pontiff (2020): levels bet against anomalies

confirmatory_family.name: price_target_upside
confirmatory_family.signal: mean target / price - 1; top decile long. (Absolute is optimism-biased per EMP-2020; within-industry ranking is the stronger form — optional sector-neutral variant.)
confirmatory_family.pre_registered_expectation: FAILS absolute; within-industry variant is exploratory

descriptive_companions.name: forecast_dispersion_avoid
descriptive_companions.note: tradable side is the SHORT leg; long-only large-cap is weak — descriptive only

multiplicity: Holm within the N=3 Phase-2 confirmatory family (authoritative, Sharpe-of-excess). If run jointly with Phase 1 (evebitda) + Phase 4 (vrp), the overall joint family is N=5 — report both the within-phase Holm(3) and the joint Holm(5).
robustness_required_if_positive: Phase 5 cross-sectional battery (characteristic-shuffle/random-decile placebo + decile-breakpoint sweep + 3 sub-periods + GFC/COVID exclusion + commission sweep). Plus a turnover/capacity audit (revision momentum is high-turnover) and a small-cap-concentration check (the evidence says analyst alpha concentrates in small/illiquid names OUTSIDE this large-cap universe).
expected_overall: 0/3 pass, most likely — but est_revision_momentum is the single signal in the entire program with a credible (if unlikely) path to clearing the gate. This is the test the free-data ceiling prevented.
